[Quarto](https://quarto.org/) turns Markdown into websites, books,
presentations, and other publication formats. `quarto-marimo` adds reactive
Python, SQL, and Markdown cells to those publications.

The extension compiles each document's `.marimo` cells into one marimo app.
Quarto places each result at its authored position and publishes the surrounding
document.

```{python .marimo}
#| echo: true
import marimo as mo

slider = mo.ui.slider(start=1, stop=10, label="Exclamation marks")
slider
```

```{python .marimo}
mo.md(f"## Hello from marimo{'!' * slider.value}")
```

Changing the slider reruns the dependent cell in the browser.

## Install the extension

Install Quarto 1.9.20 or newer, then add `quarto-marimo`:

```bash
quarto add marimo-team/quarto-marimo
```

## Create a reactive page

Create `index.qmd`:

````markdown
---
title: Reactive Quarto page
engine: marimo
format: html
---

```python {.marimo}
import marimo as mo

slider = mo.ui.slider(1, 10, 1, label="Items")
slider
```

```python {.marimo}
mo.md(f"The slider is set to **{slider.value}**.")
```
````

Preview the page:

```bash
quarto preview
```

HTML output remains interactive in the browser. Formats such as PDF receive the
evaluated cell output.

## Convert a marimo notebook

Convert an existing marimo notebook to Quarto Markdown:

```bash
marimo export md notebook.py -o notebook.qmd
```

Use the tutorials in the sidebar to explore marimo dataflow, UI elements,
Markdown, plots, layouts, SQL, and external dependencies inside Quarto.
